text: Nail Kiss is an absolute gem! I’ve been a loyal customer since summer 2025, and before that, I neglected my nails. Now, I indulge in builder gel and shellac pedicures. The staff at Nail Kiss is incredibly attentive and caring, making me feel so comfortable and pampered. I genuinely enjoy the experience and eagerly look forward to my monthly visits. I highly recommend Nail Kiss to everyone!  On a special note, they offer a birthday discount of five dollars off your treatment, along with either lotion or cuticle oil. I’m excited to try their cuticle oil!

bit overpriced for a basic mid length french tip set, i ended up paying 90$ w/tip for a normal set i would get for 75$ with my normal girl.  did a beautiful job though, prices just need to be more transparent.

I was a bit hesitant to try a new nail place but wow I was blown away! I got one of the best manicures of my life and got the prettiest ombré I’ve ever gotten! The salon is very clean and my tech was very knowledgeable and friendly! I will definitely be recommending Nails Kiss to all my friends!

This was my first time getting my nails done here, and Sophia did an amazing job. I came in because my previous set was way too thick, and I was so unhappy with how they looked. Sophia completely transformed them and they look so much better. She was incredibly detail oriented and made sure everything was perfect. I was so happy with the results that I already booked my next appointment with her. I highly recommend seeing Sophia!

Came here just before Thanksgiving last year for the first time. The experience, and service was great.  Came again. When asked if I wanted champagne (its a service thats offered), I said yes. The manicure pedicure was great and the chair was comfortable.  I know it sounds silly, but drinking champagne, having a pedicure and conversations would have been very relaxing after a busy work weekend.

Very impressed with the speed and results! My normal nail tech at a different salon is out for a few weeks and with my nails being overdue for a redo, I booked a builder gel appointment here for the first time with Kim. She did new builder gel set, fixed/formed two of my broken shorter nails, and executed my design all within just over an hour!  As for the salon, the receptionist was very helpful and friendly, the salon is clean and luxurious feeling.

Came here (after making an appointment online) for a standard pedicure and polish change on my hands. The lady started giving me a regular manicure, though that's not what I asked for, so I stopped her. From there, the lady did my nails, told me it would take 10 munutes for my nails to dry, then walked off. I had to turn the fan on to dry my nails myself.
Cindy gave me the best pedicure I’ve had yet! And my two go-to people for my nails are Sophia and Kim - they both do an amazing job!!!!
